event: Karthik Live! — multi-city concert tour, Bengaluru show
identityConfidence: HIGH — resolved to a specific show. 'Karthik Live!' is a TribeVibe Entertainment concert tour featuring playback singer Karthik, spanning ten to eleven South Indian cities (Tirupati, Vizag, Coimbatore, Cochin, Rajahmundry, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Vijayawada, Chennai, Madurai, Warangal), opening 30 November 2025. The BENGALURU show is listed for 7 February 2026, 7:30–9:30 pm, at Phoenix Market City, Whitefield. Ticketing exclusively via BookMyShow.
